public class DroneBattery {
    private int charge;
    private int flights;

    public DroneBattery(int initialCharge) {
        charge = initialCharge;
        flights = 0;
    }

    public int getCharge() {
        return charge;
    }

    public int getFlights() {
        return flights;
    }

    public boolean canFly(int requiredCharge) {
        return requiredCharge > 0 && requiredCharge <= charge;
    }

    public boolean completeFlight(int requiredCharge) {
        if (requiredCharge <= 0 || requiredCharge > charge) {
            return false;
        }
        int remaining = charge - requiredCharge;
        charge = remaining;
        flights++;
        return true;
    }

    public void recharge(int amount) {
        if (amount > 0) {
            int updatedCharge = charge + amount;
            if (updatedCharge > 100) {
                updatedCharge = 100;
            }
            charge = updatedCharge;
        }
    }
}
